name: QUEST-FOE-LINE-any-resource
note: A quest person's or item's behaviour answers a foe's line.

name: QUEST-FOE-LINE-before-the-journal
old: if (!quest.getLogMessages?.()?.length) return null;   // Quest.GetLogMessages: none once the quest has ended, too
note: A quest that has written nothing in the journal, or has ended, is named on the plaque - the Quest Guide's second law broken.

name: QUEST-FOE-LINE-nameless-quest
note: A quest with no display name hangs a bare "Quest: " under its foe.

name: QUEST-FOE-LINE-the-kind-label
note: The line keeps a "Main Quest:" label the journal's faces all cut.

name: QUEST-FOE-LINE-no-line
note: The plaque names the Rogue and nothing ties it to The Assassin - the report.

name: QUEST-FOE-LINE-street-arm
old: return t ? { title: f.yielded || f._pupYield ? `${t} - beaten` : t, subs: questFoeSubs(f) } : null;
new: return t ? { title: f.yielded || f._pupYield ? `${t} - beaten` : t } : null;
note: The foe pool's own hover - the street's, and the pool every building's foes stand in - drops the line.

name: QUEST-FOE-LINE-interior-arm
old: return t ? { title: t, subs: questFoeSubs(f) } : null;
note: The interior host's live-foe arm - the report's own room - drops the line.

name: QUEST-FOE-LINE-dungeon-arm
old: return t ? { title: f.yielded ? `${t} - beaten` : t, subs: questFoeSubs(f) } : null;
new: return t ? { title: f.yielded ? `${t} - beaten` : t } : null;
note: The dungeon's live-foe arm drops the line - most restrained quest foes stand underground.
